title: AeroCopilotBench: A Two-Tier Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents as Aviation Copilots in an Interactive Virtual Cockpit Environment
abstract: arXiv:2608.16349v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents may assist flight crews with complex decisions and task execution, but existing aviation evaluations centered on static knowledge do not support systematic testing of procedural execution and safety compliance in interactive environments. This paper presents the AeroCopilot Operational Environment (ACOE), a reproducible interactive virtual-cockpit test environment, and AeroCopilotBench, a two-tier aviation agent evaluation benchmark. Tier-1 evaluates aviation knowledge using 1,200 multiple-choice questions, while Tier-2 comprises 73 emergency and abnormal tasks derived from the manufacturers' Pilot's Operating Handbooks (POHs) and instantiated in ACOE. translated_title: AeroCopilotBench：一个在交互式虚拟驾驶舱环境中评估LLM智能体作为航空副驾驶的双层基准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体可能协助飞行机组进行复杂决策和任务执行，但现有的以静态知识为中心的航空评估不支持在交互环境中对程序执行和安全合规性进行系统性测试。本文提出了AeroCopilot操作环境（ACOE），一个可复现的交互式虚拟驾驶舱测试环境，以及AeroCopilotBench，一个双层航空智能体评估基准。第一层使用1200道多项选择题评估航空知识，而第二层包含73个来自制造商飞行员操作手册（POHs）并在ACOE中实例化的紧急和异常任务。ACOE将自然语言程序转换为可执行的状态转换、最终状态目标条件和硬性安全约束，使模型能够通过标准化工具解释驾驶舱状态、诊断故障并操作飞机系统。
tldr: 本文提出了一个双层航空基准AeroCopilotBench和可复现的虚拟驾驶舱环境ACOE，用于系统评估LLM智能体在交互环境中的程序执行和飞行安全合规能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AeroCopilotBench, a two-tier aviation benchmark, and the ACOE virtual cockpit environment to systematically evaluate LLM agents' procedural execution and flight safety compliance in interactive settings.
